{{recipe}}

'''Kiwi and Asian pear in lemon sauce''' (kiwo to nashi no lemon ae) makes a delicious and refreshing summer dish.

==Ingredients==

=== Lemon dressing ===
*Finely-[[Cookbook:Grating|grated]] fresh peel of 1 small [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] fresh [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*½ tsp [[Cookbook:Sesame Oil|sesame oil]]

=== Fruit ===
*2 [[Cookbook:Kiwifruit|kiwifruit]], peeled, [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]], and cut into thin strips
*1 crisp [[Cookbook:Asian Pear|Asian pear]], sliced, and cut into thin strips (crisp Anjou pear may be substituted)
*½ yellow or red [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]], cut into thin strips
*½ European [[Cookbook:Cucumber|cucumber]], halved, seeded, and cut into thin strips
*1 tbsp lightly-roasted black [[Cookbook:Sesame Seed|sesame seeds]]

==Procedure==
#[[Cookbook:Whisk|Whisk]] the lemon dressing ingredients together in a serving bowl, and set aside.
#Add the fruit to the bowl of lemon dressing. [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]], cover, and chill for about an hour.
